name: Muzical Chairz
bio: Muzical Chairz is a cover band playing multi-genre hits. They play venues around Thousand Oaks like Tarantula Hill Brewing and Crown and Anchor, and they also play private parties and weddings.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from the Muzical Chairz Facebook page.
source: public web search and the band's public Instagram profile, 2026-10-29
